entities.summary: Theodor "Todde" Malm was a Swedish amateur footballer and bandy player. He competed in the 1908 Summer Olympics and in the 1912 Summer Olympics. In the 1908 tournament he was a part of the Swedish football team and played in the only match for Sweden. Four years later he was a member of the Swedish Olympic squad. He did not play in a match, but was a reserve player.
